item.title: Sunflower Land dev announces Ronin creature-collector Yakkamon
item.summary: Thought Farm, the studio behind Sunflower Land, has unveiled Yakkamon, a new creature-collecting and idle farming game launching on Ronin in early access during Q4 2026. Players will hunt and catch creatures known as Yakkamon before putting them to work farming, gathering resources and producing items.
